serverInfo.title: risk_exposure_api
serverInfo.description: MCP server for the risk_exposure_api service.

tools.name: GET_suppliers_smVendorId_exposures
tools.title: GET_suppliers_smVendorId_exposures
tools.description: This API fetches the overall and category risk exposure for the given smVendorId. The API accepts the query parameter realm to get the supplier details for the specified realm.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: If specified, this Locale will be used for translation.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: This parameter specifies one of the realm names for which the client application is authenticated and provides access to the data in that realm. Try it out on Sandbox with: s4All-3

parameters.name: smVendorId
parameters.description: The supplier you are retrieving risk exposure for.

tools.name: POST_suppliers_exposureRequest_pages_pageNo
tools.title: POST_suppliers_exposureRequest_pages_pageNo
tools.description: This API fetches the overall and category risk exposure for the given list of smVendorIds or ERPVendorIDs. The API accepts the query parameter realm to get the supplier details for the specified realm.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: If specified, this Locale will be used for translation.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: This parameter specifies one of the realm names for which the client application is authenticated and provides access to the data in that realm. Try it out on Sandbox with: s4All-3
